$comment: Voice-changer input denoisers (owned by P3-A; ids in vc/assets.rs). Upstream ONNX files, pinned; checks and contracts: scripts/vc-templates/export_denoise.py (reports/denoise.json). Written by scripts/assets/vc_catalog.py.

vc/denoise-gtcrn: GTCRN streaming (16 kHz): mix [1,257,1,2] (512-point STFT frame of a sqrt-Hann window, hop 256) + conv_cache [2,1,16,16,33], tra_cache [2,3,1,1,16], inter_cache [2,1,33,16] -> enh [1,257,1,2] + the next caches.

vc/denoise-dfn3: DeepFilterNet3 (48 kHz, 960-point STFT, hop 480): enc.onnx, erb_dec.onnx, df_dec.onnx and config.ini (every DSP constant), extracted from the upstream tar.gz (two leading folders stripped).
vc/denoise-dpdfnet: DPDFNet-2 48 kHz HR: spec [1,1,481,2] (960-point STFT frame at 48 kHz, hop 480) + state_in [56436] -> spec_e [1,1,481,2] + state_out.

entries.title: GTCRN denoiser
entries.description: Removes background noise from the voice changer's input with almost no CPU. About 0.5 MB.

entries.title: DeepFilterNet3 denoiser
entries.description: High-quality noise removal for the voice changer's input (48 kHz). About 8 MB.

entries.title: DPDFNet denoiser
entries.description: High-quality streaming noise removal for the voice changer's input (48 kHz). About 10 MB.
